_doc: THOUGHT-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): thought leadership as a closed loop. Every white paper the research loop writes (research/studies, research/papers, site/research-data.js) is turned into posts that state a common belief about AI limits, what this system's own records show, and the hook: Ultrastable runs on Ultrastable, and Practical Solutions is one system it runs. Read by foundation/thought.py (python3 -m foundation thought --check|--run [--apply]|--preview). Posts go into social/calendar.json, which the tick Worker's publisher (seed/worker/src/social.js) and the social-post workflow drain within social/gate.json. Reach comes back through first-party referrals (foundation/reach.py arm 'paper') and re-weights nothing by hand.

consent.source: project thread 'Build thought leadership and social reach'
consent.scope: white papers and their posts on the owner's own and the project's own social accounts, LinkedIn included; Practical Solutions may use the QNFO social accounts (granted separately); no cold messages to individuals

ps.name: Practical Solutions
ps.what: a free, evidence-based catalogue of fixes for global problems that keeps its own evidence current

hook.short: Ultrastable runs on Ultrastable and writes these papers itself.
hook.medium: Ultrastable runs on Ultrastable: it writes, measures and republishes these papers from its own records. Practical Solutions is one system it runs.
hook.long: Why this is on my feed: Ultrastable runs on Ultrastable. Its fixes, deploys and these white papers are produced and checked by the system itself, from its own records. Practical Solutions is one example of a system it runs: {ps_what}. The subject is the example; the point is what a self-running system can do for your own work.
